user.title: Set up family calendar
user.description: Choose your German federal state. It determines public holidays and school holidays.

data_description.show_school_holidays: Downloads the school holidays once a day from the internet via the OpenHolidays API (only the state is sent, never your events). When switched off, the calendar itself does not access the internet; public holidays are always calculated offline.

personen.title: People
personen.description: Enter up to 10 people. Empty fields stay free and can be added later under “Configure”, where you also set colours, language and notifications.

error.keine_person: Please enter at least one person.

menu_options.personen: People (name, colour, active, push notification, language)

personen.title: Choose person
personen.description: Which person do you want to edit? (✓ = active, ✗ = inactive, — = free) The 🏠 Household entry is for events without a specific person (e.g. bins, tradespeople).

person.title: Edit person {slot}
person.description: Only active people are shown in the calendar. For push reminders choose the phone's notification service (e.g. notify.mobile_app_…). In addition to the push message, the reminder can be announced – on speakers (media players) or on Alexa. For Alexa choose the “… Announce” entity of the “Alexa Devices” integration (or notify.alexa_media_… for “Alexa Media Player”).

berechtigungen.title: Permissions
berechtigungen.description: Set what each Home Assistant account may do in the calendar. Administrators always have full rights and are not listed. “Default” applies to accounts added later.

data.assumption_by: Assumption Day as public holiday (Bavaria only, applies in predominantly Catholic municipalities)

data_description.show_school_holidays: Downloads the school holidays once a day from the internet via the OpenHolidays API (only the state is sent, never your events). When switched off, the calendar itself does not access the internet; public holidays are always calculated offline.

erinnerungen.title: Reminders
erinnerungen.description: These reminders are preselected for new events. All-day events remind at the time set here.

wandtablet.title: Wall tablet mode
wandtablet.description: Which Home Assistant accounts should use wall tablet mode? The calendar then jumps back to “Today” after a period without interaction, shows a large clock and dims at night.

data_description.kiosk_solid: Only enable if small lighter boxes appear on the wall tablet (some Android tablets/Fully Kiosk). The card then uses solid colours; a see-through theme background is no longer visible on the tablet.

sicherung.title: Automatic backup
sicherung.description: Once a week all events are saved as an ICS file in /config/familienkalender_backup/ics/ (in addition to the regular Home Assistant backup).

sprachansage.title: Voice announcements
sprachansage.description: Reminders are also announced when speakers or Alexa devices are set for a person (Configure → People). No announcements during quiet hours.

data.test: Play a test announcement after saving

error.name_fehlt: An active person needs a name.
